# Entity-related deletes cascade to dependent rows

Foreign keys from relationships, provenance, and embeddings to entities declare ondelete='CASCADE' so deleting an entity will cascade-delete those dependent rows.

Maintain referential integrity by removing dependent records when an entity is removed.
